request.style: English, soul, male solo voice, deep and warm, upright bass, piano, soft drums, cello, organ, reverent and steady, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Jerahmeel are told
From Hezron’s firstborn line
Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem
And Ahijah shine
Another wife was Atarah
She bore the son Onam
Shammai and Jada followed
Through the years to come

[Verse]
Sheshan had no sons, only daughters
He gave his child away
To Jarha, his Egyptian servant
In that simple day
Attai came from that union
Nathan, then Zabad
Ephlal and Obed followed
In the written record

[Chorus]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
Sismai fathered Shallum
Shallum fathered Jekamiah
Jekamiah fathered Elishama

[Verse]
Obed fathered Jehu, sure
Jehu fathered Azariah
Azariah fathered Helez
Helez fathered Eleasah
The names are kept in the book
For Israel’s memory
Tribal identity preserved
In the family tree

[Chorus]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
Sismai fathered Shallum
Shallum fathered Jekamiah
Jekamiah fathered Elishama

[Bridge]
God’s faithfulness holds the line
Through generations of men
The royal blood of Judah
Endures until the end

[Chorus]
Eleasah fathered Sismai
Sismai fathered Shallum
Shallum fathered Jekamiah
Jekamiah fathered Elishama

[Outro]
Shallum fathered Jekamiah
Jekamiah fathered Elishama
